name: @projexlight/i18n
summary: Locale + message catalog primitives — typed message keys, ICU MessageFormat support, per-tenant brand + locale override. Used by sdk-notification template bodies, admin UI strings, audit reason text. Pure runtime resolution; no build-time codegen.

hooks.name: t
hooks.description: Resolve a message key + params against a locale.

hooks.name: registerCatalog
hooks.description: Register a tenant-scoped message catalog override.

hooks.name: listLocales
hooks.description: List the locales the runtime currently supports.

scenarios.title: Resolve a templated message
scenarios.when_to_use: Notification template renders the body — t() handles plural / gender / date formatting.
scenarios.example_code:
import { t } from '@projexlight/i18n';
const body = t({ locale: 'es-MX', key: 'tech-eta-sms', params: { tech_name, eta_start } });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns the locale-correct string. Falls back to default locale if key missing in target.

scenarios.title: Tenant-scoped message override
scenarios.when_to_use: Tenant wants to override the default 'Welcome' message; register their catalog and it takes precedence.
scenarios.example_code:
import { registerCatalog } from '@projexlight/i18n';
registerCatalog({ tenant_id, locale: 'en-US', overrides: { welcome: 'Glad you joined Acme!' } });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Future t() calls for that tenant return the override; other tenants unaffected.

scenarios.title: Missing key falls through the fallback chain
scenarios.when_to_use: Key not found in es-MX → fallback to es → fallback to en. Configurable chain.
scenarios.example_code:
// configured: I18N_FALLBACK_CHAIN=es-MX,es,en
// runtime: t({ key: 'rare-key', locale: 'es-MX' }) → returns en value if only en defined
scenarios.expected_outcome: Always returns *something* readable. Missing-key telemetry counter increments so translators can fill gaps.

compliance_posture.notes: All notifications + UI strings resolve through here, so satisfying GDPR's transparent-information requirement (notice must be in subject's language) is a single config away.
